question: On the diffs where this batch's reviewers found real defects, which of three behaviours of the coordinator's per-round briefs carries the effect on a reviewer under omp's shipped prompt: naming the user-visible loss (loss), naming which earlier finding to re-break (rebreak), or demanding a reproduction rather than a reading (repro)? With false claims beside every recall figure.
decision: Stage 2 runs the static form of the behaviour(s) that carry the effect, appended to the shipped prompt, against a fresh shipped arm; that is the prompt change.

facts_before_launch.baseline_reproduced: claims.ts on runs/claims-2026-10-31/current gives 5 / 364, as reported. 364 is (defect, run) opportunities over 123 defects at 23 heads, not 364 defects.
facts_before_launch.grader: The frozen patterns miss paraphrase. Two judges of different families (judge-match.md) on the 140 claims of the three earlier arms: 28 agreed matches, 1 disputed, 111 none; patterns hit 14, of which the panel agreed 13; all 15 panel-only matches were read by hand and are the recorded defect. Judged, the shipped prompt finds 9 / 369 = 2.4% (Wilson 1.3-4.6%).
facts_before_launch.how_found: corpus/how-found.jsonl: of 274 defects found in their round, the finding brief stated the defect for 60 (both labellers) to 116 (either), named its area for 162-236, named an earlier finding it re-breaks for 111-202, named its user-visible loss for 5-14, nothing for 0-2. Cohen's kappa 0.50.
facts_before_launch.coordinator_account: The coordinator's account was that the briefs repeatedly named the user-visible loss rather than the code area. The corpus disagrees (5-14 of 274 defects; the round's own brief names a loss at 3 of 23 heads); the corpus is what is measured. The loss arm therefore uses every loss sentence the coordinator wrote for the pull request up to the round.
facts_before_launch.pilot: 1 session: 199 s, 34 requests, memory.peak 1.09 GiB, max 0. 2 sessions at concurrency 2: 394 s and 448 s, 52 requests each, memory.peak 1.60 GiB, memory.events max 0, scratch kept 0.1-0.2 MiB, load1 298-335.

design_review.by: Claude Opus 5 subagent DesignReviewBriefLane, 2026-11-01, adversarial, against the requester's words

stopping_findings_and_answers.A1 fix-claims point at their still-open: Kept: naming the earlier finding and the fix's claim is the rebreak behaviour. Those defects are classified by both judges (judge-reopen.md, cases-brief.json reopens: 46 at the 19 heads) and recall is reported on them and on the rest separately.
stopping_findings_and_answers.A2 kept attack spans enumerate defects: Every kept span of every arm now goes through both judges (judge-leak.md); one flag removes it. Where both judges call a sentence area-level and keep it, it stays; the reviewer's remaining examples are listed in the result as judged-area.
stopping_findings_and_answers.A3 loss leak check exempted loss sentenc: Exemption removed from judge-leak.md; the same title-writable test for every sentence.
stopping_findings_and_answers.A4 only the first-started brief de-leake: A span stating a case in the round's other brief now removes the same text in the source brief.
stopping_findings_and_answers.C11 shipped prompt forbids running: Every arm's user prompt says the scratch directory is writable and runnable; constant across arms.
stopping_findings_and_answers.C12 control already instructs R and P: Removed from the brief lane's shared prompt: no shared replay instruction, no 'any output you measured'.
stopping_findings_and_answers.D13 verifier verdict crossed arms: One representative per (group, arm), with that arm's own scratch; a verdict applies only to its arm.
stopping_findings_and_answers.other: Shipped gets the brief heading with '(none for this round)' (B9); element order rotates by head (B10); disputed matches are verified (D14); patterns are not claimed as a defence (D15); defect-weighted estimates and pull-request-cluster intervals (E16, E17); 4 heads with 1-2 defects dropped (E18); static forms prepared for stage 2 (F20); composition per head recorded (B7, B8).

dropped_heads.why: 1 or 2 recorded defects each: their recall can only be 0, 0.5 or 1, they add noise and sessions; dropping them raises power (design review E18). 117 of 123 defects kept.

subject.dropped_cases: None. The line between pressure and the answer is drawn per sentence: every removed span and loss sentence is in cases-brief.json with its reason.

arms.model: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, thinking high, 20 minutes, tools read,grep,glob,bash,write,edit, one fresh session per (arm, head, trial)

measures.recall: recorded defects found per diff; a defect is found when both match judges (openai/gpt-6-astra, anthropic/claude-opus-5) name it for one claimed section. Frozen patterns and either-judge reported beside.
measures.precision: real / (real + false) over claimed sections: real when tied to a recorded defect or its (group, arm) verified REAL; false when tied to a decoy or verified NOT-REAL; unknown counted beside.
measures.cost: model requests, output tokens and wall minutes per diff; load1 and runnable/blocked tasks at each session's start and end; scope memory.peak and memory.events max. No dollar figure is reported.

analysis.estimator: per head, an arm's recall over its trials; differences per head; mean over heads weighted by the head's number of recorded defects
analysis.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap resampling pull requests (8 clusters), 10,000 draws, seed 20261101; head-level interval shown beside as the optimistic bound
analysis.primary: the three factorial main effects on recall (loss, rebreak, repro), each with the change in false claims per diff
analysis.secondary: differences of main effects (which carries more); full-brief minus loss-rebreak-repro (what the rest of the brief adds); recall on re-opened named findings and on the rest; recall not in the earlier round
analysis.carries_the_effect: a behaviour carries the effect when its main effect's pull-request interval lies above 0 and its change in false claims per diff has an upper bound below +0.5. One behaviour carries more than another only when the interval of their difference excludes 0.
analysis.exclusions: an errored run is excluded from n and listed; a head missing any of its eight cells is left out of the main effects
analysis.stage_2_rule: run shipped plus the static form of every behaviour that carries the effect (and static-all when more than one does), 19 heads x 2 trials each; if none carries it, run shipped plus the static form of the largest point estimate and label it exploratory

budgets.disk: run directory cap 40 GiB; stop when /mnt/nvme has under 45 GiB free; caches pruned by name per session, every other file kept and files over 8 MiB named
